units.source_text: 源氏公子不辨此人是谁。

en.t: Prince Genji could not tell who this person was.

units.source_text: 他但愿自己不被人认出，只管踮着脚尖悄悄地退出去。

en.t: He only hoped that no one would recognize him, and quietly withdrew on tiptoe.

units.source_text: 头中将却走过来了，他抱怨道：

en.t: But To no Chujo came over and complained:

units.source_text: “你半途上抛开了我，教我好恨！

en.t: You abandoned me halfway, and I resent it terribly!

units.source_text: 我就亲自送你到这里来了。

en.t: So I have come here myself to see you all the way to this place.
